reason: I wait for a Groupon or a free trial day before I try anything new, and this is not open yet and has no trial. $59 a month for one kid, plus $15 for my second, is a commitment I would not make blind.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up. A membership only pays off if I go several times a month, and I would not know that until I had tried it.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial day or a Groupon-style first-visit deal, or a punch card where visits do not expire, so I can try it before paying monthly.
